"""Look kit CLI: one command gives an arbitrary scene a finished look (lighting, atmosphere, weather, lens).

    blender -b scene.blend --python look.py -- --look rain-night [--quality preview|final] [--set key=val ...]
        [--save [OUT.blend]] [--render OUT.png [--frame N]] [--animation OUT_DIR/ [--budget-min 15]] [--percent P]
    blender -b scene.blend --python look.py -- --remove [--save]
    blender -b --python look.py -- --list            (looks, layers, every parameter with its default)

Looks: rain-night, fog-forest, neon-interior, night-city, golden-hour, overcast, studio-product, wet-product.
Layers (alone, on top of the scene's own lighting): fog, godrays, rain, snow, wet, practicals, camera.

What it does: reads the scene (camera, subject in frame, ground, emissive objects, indoor/outdoor), then adds
tagged objects only (custom property ``look_kit``): world sky, a sun, practical lights at every emissive object,
a height-fog volume, a hidden light blocker for shafts, rain/snow geometry nodes with splashes, a removable wet
node in each material, water beads, a softbox rig. Sets EEVEE (ray tracing, volumetrics, shadows) or Cycles
for --quality final where the look needs it, AgX + contrast look, auto exposure from a small probe render,
bloom, depth of field, lens distortion, vignette and grain. Re-running replaces the previous look; --remove
undoes it. The user's objects are never deleted (their sun lamps are hidden by night/studio looks).

Prints one line ``LOOK_JSON {...}`` (what it did, timings, files) on stdout; exits 1 with ``look: error: ...``.
`--save` with no path overwrites the opened .blend. Also importable: ``import look; look.apply(scene, name)``.
"""
import argparse
import json
import os
import sys
import time

sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))


class LookError(Exception):
    pass


class Parser(argparse.ArgumentParser):
    def error(self, message):
        raise LookError(message)


def parse(argv):
    p = Parser(prog="look.py", allow_abbrev=False, description=__doc__, formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter)
    p.add_argument("--look", help="look or layer name")
    p.add_argument("--quality", default="preview", choices=["preview", "final"])
    p.add_argument("--set", action="append", default=[], metavar="KEY=VAL", help="override a parameter (see --list)")
    p.add_argument("--save", nargs="?", const="", default=None, metavar="OUT.blend")
    p.add_argument("--render", metavar="OUT.png", help="render one still after applying")
    p.add_argument("--frame", type=int, help="frame for --render (default: the scene's current frame)")
    p.add_argument("--animation", metavar="OUT_DIR",
                   help="render the scene's frame range with edit-in-blender's render-final.py into OUT_DIR (final.mp4, preview.mp4 early)")
    p.add_argument("--budget-min", type=float, default=15,
                   help="--animation: wall-clock minutes; it fits samples/size/engine and returns before this (default 15)")
    p.add_argument("--percent", type=int, help="render size as a percentage of the scene's resolution")
    p.add_argument("--remove", action="store_true", help="undo the look kit")
    p.add_argument("--list", action="store_true")
    a = p.parse_args(argv)
    if not (a.list or a.remove or a.look):
        raise LookError("give --look NAME, --remove or --list")
    return a


def main(argv):
    try:
        a = parse(argv)
        import bpy
        import look
        if a.list:
            print("LOOK_JSON " + json.dumps(look.list_looks()))
            return 0
        scene = bpy.context.scene
        out = {}
        t0 = time.time()
        if a.remove:
            look.remove(scene)
            out["removed"] = True
        else:
            overrides = {}
            for kv in a.set:
                if "=" not in kv:
                    raise LookError(f"--set wants KEY=VAL, got {kv!r}")
                k, v = kv.split("=", 1)
                overrides[k.strip()] = v.strip()
            if a.percent:
                scene.render.resolution_percentage = a.percent
            if a.frame is not None:
                scene.frame_set(a.frame)
            try:
                out = look.apply(scene, a.look, quality=a.quality, **overrides)
            except ValueError as e:
                raise LookError(str(e))
        files = []
        if a.save is not None:
            path = a.save or bpy.data.filepath
            if not path:
                raise LookError("--save needs a path (the scene was never saved)")
            os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(path)), exist_ok=True)
            bpy.ops.wm.save_as_mainfile(filepath=os.path.abspath(path), copy=bool(a.save) and a.save != bpy.data.filepath)
            files.append(os.path.abspath(path))
        if a.render:
            r = scene.render
            r.filepath = os.path.abspath(a.render)
            r.image_settings.file_format = "PNG"
            t = time.time()
            look.render.safe_render(scene, write_still=True)
            out["render_s"] = round(time.time() - t, 2)
            files.append(r.filepath)
        if a.animation:
            # The budgeted final renderer lives in the sibling edit-in-blender skill; it always returns a video
            # inside --budget-min.
            import subprocess
            render_final = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)), "..", "..", "edit-in-blender",
                                        "scripts", "render-final.py")
            if not os.path.isfile(render_final):
                raise LookError(f"--animation needs the edit-in-blender skill's render-final.py at {os.path.normpath(render_final)}")
            folder = os.path.abspath(a.animation)
            os.makedirs(folder, exist_ok=True)
            blend = os.path.abspath(a.save) if a.save else os.path.join(folder, "scene.blend")
            if not a.save:
                bpy.ops.wm.save_as_mainfile(filepath=blend, copy=True)
            # Run render-final in Blender's own Python: no system python3 is needed (macOS sys.executable is Blender).
            t = time.time()
            result = subprocess.run(
                [bpy.app.binary_path, "-b", "--factory-startup", "--python-exit-code", "1", "--python", render_final,
                 "--", blend, "--out", folder, "--budget-min", str(a.budget_min), "--blender", bpy.app.binary_path],
                stdout=subprocess.PIPE, text=True)
            if result.returncode:
                raise LookError(f"render-final.py failed ({result.returncode}); see its message above")
            summary = [line for line in result.stdout.splitlines() if line.startswith("{")]
            if not summary:
                raise LookError("render-final.py printed no summary; see its message above")
            out["animation"] = json.loads(summary[-1])
            out["animation_s"] = round(time.time() - t, 2)
            files.append(out["animation"].get("video", folder))
        if look.render.FALLBACK:
            out.update(look.render.FALLBACK)
            out["gpu"] = False
        out["files"] = files
        out["total_s"] = round(time.time() - t0, 2)
        print("LOOK_JSON " + json.dumps(out), flush=True)
        return 0
    except LookError as e:
        print(f"look: error: {e}", file=sys.stderr, flush=True)
        return 1
    except Exception as e:  # report Blender/API failures in one line, not a traceback wall
        import traceback
        traceback.print_exc()
        print(f"look: error: {type(e).__name__}: {e}", file=sys.stderr, flush=True)
        return 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    argv = sys.argv[sys.argv.index("--") + 1:] if "--" in sys.argv else []
    code = main(argv)
    if code:
        sys.exit(code)

"""The look layers. Each takes (scene, info, p) where p is the merged parameter dict, adds only tagged objects /
datablocks, and records any change to user data in the scene's look-kit state so remove() can undo it."""
import math
import random
import re

import bpy
from mathutils import Euler, Vector

from . import library
from .core import (COLLECTION, kit_collection, new_object, save_state, state, tag, tagged, volume_only)
from .nodes import Tree, sock


def kelvin(k):
    """Approximate blackbody colour (linear-ish RGB) for 1000-12000 K."""
    t = k / 100.0
    r = 255 if t <= 66 else 329.698727446 * ((t - 60) ** -0.1332047592)
    g = 99.4708025861 * math.log(t) - 161.1195681661 if t <= 66 else 288.1221695283 * ((t - 60) ** -0.0755148492)
    b = 255 if t >= 66 else (0 if t <= 19 else 138.5177312231 * math.log(t - 10) - 305.0447927307)
    srgb = [min(max(c, 0), 255) / 255 for c in (r, g, b)]
    return tuple(c ** 2.2 for c in srgb)


def time_driver(socket):
    """Drive a node input with scene seconds (frame / fps); a simple expression, so it runs without Python
    script auto-execution."""
    r = bpy.context.scene.render
    fc = socket.driver_add("default_value")
    fc.driver.type = "SCRIPTED"
    fc.driver.expression = f"frame / {r.fps / r.fps_base:.4f}"
    return fc


# ---------------- world / sky / sun ----------------

def resolve_sun(scene, info, p):
    """sun_azimuth=auto: try azimuths in the look's preferred range and keep the one that lights the most of what
    the camera sees (a street canyon or a forest would otherwise put the shot in shadow)."""
    if p["sun_azimuth"] != "auto":
        return
    lo, hi_ = p["sun_azimuth_range"]
    best, best_score = (lo + hi_) / 2, -1.0
    dg = bpy.context.evaluated_depsgraph_get()
    pts = _view_points(scene, info, dg)
    if info.indoor:  # a room: any direction that gets the sun through a window, at a few heights
        tries = [(a, min(e, 75.0)) for a in range(-180, 180, 15)
                 for e in (p["sun_elevation"], p["sun_elevation"] + 15, p["sun_elevation"] + 30)]
    else:
        tries = [(az * side, p["sun_elevation"]) for side in (1, -1) for az in range(int(lo), int(hi_) + 1, 15)]
    for a, el in tries:
        s = sun_vector(info, el, a)
        lit = sum(1 for pt in pts if not _blocked(scene, dg, pt, s))
        score = lit / max(len(pts), 1) - (0.0005 if info.indoor else 0.002) * abs(abs(a) - p["sun_azimuth_prefer"])
        if score > best_score:
            best, best_score = (a, el), score
    p["sun_azimuth"], p["sun_elevation"] = float(best[0]), float(best[1])
    p["sun_lit_share"] = round(best_score, 2)


def _see_through(ob):
    """Glass panes, sheer curtains and the kit's own helpers let sunlight through."""
    ob = ob.original if hasattr(ob, "original") else ob
    if tagged(ob) or volume_only(ob) or re.search(r"glass|pane|window|curtain|sheer|net", ob.name, re.I) and not re.search(r"frame|sill", ob.name, re.I):
        return True
    for slot in getattr(ob, "material_slots", []):
        m = slot.material
        if m is not None and m.use_nodes:
            for n in m.node_tree.nodes:
                if n.type == "BSDF_PRINCIPLED" and (n.inputs["Transmission Weight"].default_value > 0.5 or
                                                    (not n.inputs["Alpha"].is_linked and n.inputs["Alpha"].default_value < 0.5)):
                    return True
    return False


def _blocked(scene, dg, pt, s):
    o = pt + s * 0.02
    for _ in range(6):
        ok, loc, _n, _i, ob, _m = scene.ray_cast(dg, o, s, distance=1000)
        if not ok:
            return False
        if not _see_through(ob):
            return True
        o = loc + s * 0.01
    return True


def _view_points(scene, info, dg):
    cam = info.camera
    frame = [cam.matrix_world @ v for v in cam.data.view_frame(scene=scene)]
    out = []
    for i in range(9):
        for j in range(6):
            top = frame[0].lerp(frame[3], (i + 0.5) / 9)
            bot = frame[1].lerp(frame[2], (i + 0.5) / 9)
            t = bot.lerp(top, (j + 0.5) / 6)
            ok, loc, nrm, *_r = scene.ray_cast(dg, info.cam_loc, (t - info.cam_loc).normalized(), distance=info.depth * 3)
            if ok:
                out.append(loc + nrm * 0.01)
    return out


def sun_vector(info, elevation_deg, azimuth_deg):
    """azimuth relative to the camera: 0 = sun ahead of the camera (backlight), 90 = from screen right,
    180 = behind the camera (front light)."""
    f = Vector((info.cam_fwd.x, info.cam_fwd.y, 0))
    if f.length < 1e-4:
        f = Vector((0, 1, 0))
    f.normalize()
    rot = Euler((0, 0, -math.radians(azimuth_deg))).to_matrix()
    h = rot @ f
    e = math.radians(elevation_deg)
    return Vector((h.x * math.cos(e), h.y * math.cos(e), math.sin(e))).normalized()


def world(scene, info, p):
    st = state(scene)
    if p["sky"] == "keep":
        return {}
    if "prev_world" not in st:
        st["prev_world"] = scene.world.name if scene.world else ""
        save_state(scene, st)
    w = bpy.data.worlds.get("Look Kit World")
    if w is None:
        w = tag(bpy.data.worlds.new("Look Kit World"), "world")
    w.use_nodes = True
    T = Tree(w.node_tree)
    T.n.clear()
    out = T.node("ShaderNodeOutputWorld", 800, 0)
    bg = T.node("ShaderNodeBackground", 600, 0)
    T.link(bg, "Background", out, "Surface")
    sky = p["sky"]
    s = sun_vector(info, p["sun_elevation"], p["sun_azimuth"])
    strength = p["sky_strength"]
    if sky in ("day", "golden", "overcast", "dawn"):
        tex = T.node("ShaderNodeTexSky", 0, 0, sky_type="MULTIPLE_SCATTERING")
        tex.sun_disc = False
        tex.sun_elevation = math.radians(p["sun_elevation"])
        tex.sun_rotation = math.atan2(s.x, s.y)
        tex.air_density = 1.0
        tex.aerosol_density = {"golden": 2.0, "dawn": 1.5}.get(sky, 1.0)
        col = sock(tex, "Color", True)
        if sky == "overcast":
            col = T.mix("RGBA", 0.82, col, (0.55, 0.58, 0.62, 1), 300, 0)
        elif sky == "dawn":
            # dawn: cooler and paler than golden hour, a lilac cast away from the sun
            col = T.mix("RGBA", 0.6, col, (0.8, 0.82, 1.0, 1), 300, 0, blend="MULTIPLY")
        T.l.new(col, sock(bg, "Color"))
    elif sky in ("night", "studio", "blue-hour"):
        tc = T.node("ShaderNodeTexCoord", -400, 0)
        sz = T.node("ShaderNodeSeparateXYZ", -200, 0)
        T.link(tc, "Generated", sz, "Vector")
        z = T.map_range(sock(sz, "Z", True), -0.05, 0.6, 0, 1, 0, 0, interp="SMOOTHSTEP")
        if sky == "night":
            horizon, zenith = p["night_horizon"], (0.0012, 0.0018, 0.0045, 1)
        elif sky == "blue-hour":
            # deep blue twilight, a touch lighter at the horizon (the sun is just below it)
            horizon, zenith = p["twilight_horizon"], p["twilight_zenith"]
        else:
            horizon, zenith = (0.035, 0.035, 0.037, 1), (0.012, 0.012, 0.013, 1)
        c = T.mix("RGBA", z, horizon, zenith, 300, 0)
        T.l.new(c, sock(bg, "Color"))
    sock(bg, "Strength").default_value = strength
    scene.world = w
    return {"sky": sky}


def sun(scene, info, p):
    if p["sun_strength"] <= 0:
        return {}
    s = sun_vector(info, p["sun_elevation"], p["sun_azimuth"])
    ld = bpy.data.lights.new("Look Kit Sun", "SUN")
    ld.energy = p["sun_strength"]
    ld.color = kelvin(p["sun_kelvin"])
    ld.angle = math.radians(p["sun_angle"])
    ld.volume_factor = p["sun_volume"]
    ob = new_object(scene, "Look Kit Sun", ld, "sun")
    ob.rotation_euler = (-s).to_track_quat("-Z", "Y").to_euler()
    return {"sun_dir": [round(v, 3) for v in s]}


def hide_user_suns(scene, p):
    """Night and studio looks hide the user's sun lamps (never delete them); remove() shows them again."""
    if not (p["hide_user_suns"] or p["hide_user_lights"]):
        return []
    st = state(scene)
    hidden = st.setdefault("hidden", [])
    for ob in scene.objects:
        if tagged(ob) or ob.type != "LIGHT" or ob.hide_render:
            continue
        if ob.data.type != "SUN" and not p["hide_user_lights"]:
            continue
        ob.hide_render = True
        hidden.append(ob.name)
    save_state(scene, st)
    return hidden


# ---------------- fog ----------------

def fog(scene, info, p):
    amount = p["fog"]
    if amount <= 0:
        return {}
    # a box around everything the camera sees, the camera inside it
    pad = max(info.depth * 0.3, 2.0)
    lo = Vector((min(info.lo.x, info.cam_loc.x) - pad, min(info.lo.y, info.cam_loc.y) - pad, info.ground_z - 0.5))
    reach = info.cam_loc + info.cam_fwd * info.depth * 1.5
    hi_ = Vector((max(info.hi.x, info.cam_loc.x, reach.x) + pad, max(info.hi.y, info.cam_loc.y, reach.y) + pad,
                  max(info.hi.z, info.cam_loc.z) + max(p["fog_height"] * 4, pad)))
    lo.x, lo.y = min(lo.x, reach.x - pad), min(lo.y, reach.y - pad)
    me = bpy.data.meshes.new("Look Kit Fog")
    c = [Vector((x, y, z)) for x in (lo.x, hi_.x) for y in (lo.y, hi_.y) for z in (lo.z, hi_.z)]
    me.from_pydata(c, [], [(0, 1, 3, 2), (4, 6, 7, 5), (0, 4, 5, 1), (2, 3, 7, 6), (0, 2, 6, 4), (1, 5, 7, 3)])
    ob = new_object(scene, "Look Kit Fog", me, "fog")
    ob.visible_shadow = False
    mat = tag(bpy.data.materials.new("Look Kit Fog"), "fog")
    mat.use_nodes = True
    T = Tree(mat.node_tree)
    T.n.clear()
    out = T.node("ShaderNodeOutputMaterial", 400, 0)
    g = T.node("ShaderNodeGroup", 0, 0)
    g.node_tree = library.ensure("LK Height Fog")
    g.name = "LK Height Fog"
    # density from the visibility the look asks for: about 5% of light gets through `visibility` metres of fog
    vis = p["fog_visibility"] or max(info.subject_dist * 4.0, 8.0)
    density = 3.0 / vis * amount
    T.set(g, Density=density, Ground=info.ground_z, Height=p["fog_height"], Haze=p["fog_haze"],
          Noise=p["fog_noise"], Anisotropy=p["fog_anisotropy"])
    sock(g, "Noise Scale").default_value = 1.0 / max(p["fog_height"] * 2, 0.5)
    sock(g, "Color").default_value = tuple(p["fog_color"]) + (1,)
    time_driver(sock(g, "Time"))
    T.link(g, "Volume", out, "Volume")
    me.materials.append(mat)
    return {"fog_density_per_m": round(density, 4), "fog_box": [[round(v, 1) for v in lo], [round(v, 1) for v in hi_]]}


# ---------------- god rays (gobo) ----------------

def godrays(scene, info, p):
    """Make light shafts read: the sun (or key) scatters in the fog; when nothing in the scene breaks the
    sunlight up, a hidden light blocker (gobo) between sun and subject casts the shafts."""
    if not p["godrays"]:
        return {}
    gobo = p["gobo"]
    s = sun_vector(info, p["sun_elevation"], p["sun_azimuth"])
    if gobo == "auto":
        # indoors the room's own openings make the shafts; outdoors a canopy blocker unless the scene is nearly roofed over
        # indoors the room's own openings make the shafts; outdoors a canopy blocker unless the scene is nearly roofed over
        gobo = "none" if info.indoor or _occluded_share(scene, info, s) > 0.85 else "leaves"
    if gobo == "none":
        return {"gobo": "none (scene already breaks the light)"}
    pattern = {"leaves": 0, "window": 1, "blinds": 2, "roof": 3}[gobo]
    target = info.subject_center.copy()
    target.z = info.ground_z + 0.3 * (info.subject_center.z - info.ground_z)
    span = max(info.depth * 1.2, info.subject_size * 4, 6.0)
    # place it high up along the sun ray, past the top of the scene
    up = max(info.hi.z - info.ground_z, 3.0) * 1.2 + 2.0
    dist = up / max(s.z, 0.15)
    centre = target + s * dist
    me = bpy.data.meshes.new("Look Kit Gobo")
    h = span * 1.2
    me.from_pydata([(-h, -h, 0), (h, -h, 0), (h, h, 0), (-h, h, 0)], [], [(0, 1, 2, 3)])
    ob = new_object(scene, "Look Kit Gobo", me, "godrays")
    ob.location = centre
    ob.rotation_euler = s.to_track_quat("Z", "Y").to_euler()
    # hidden from the camera and reflections but still casting shadows into the fog (Cycles needs
    # volume-scatter visibility on for the shafts)
    for attr in ("visible_camera", "visible_diffuse", "visible_glossy", "visible_transmission"):
        setattr(ob, attr, False)
    mat = library.ensure("LK Gobo").copy()
    tag(mat, "godrays")
    mask = mat.node_tree.nodes["LK Gobo Mask"]
    sock(mask, "Pattern").default_value = pattern
    # holes a metre or two across: shafts read as beams, not as one big lit patch
    sock(mask, "Scale").default_value = {0: 4.0, 1: span / 2.5, 2: span / 2.5, 3: 6.0}[pattern] * p["gobo_scale"] * max(info.subject_size / 6, 0.5)
    sock(mask, "Openness").default_value = p["gobo_openness"]
    me.materials.append(mat)
    return {"gobo": gobo}


def _occluded_share(scene, info, s):
    """Share of sun rays toward the visible area that something blocks (trees, roofs, walls)."""
    dg = bpy.context.evaluated_depsgraph_get()
    rnd = random.Random(1)
    hits = 0
    n = 48
    for _ in range(n):
        d = info.subject_dist * rnd.uniform(0.3, 1.6)
        side = info.cam_fwd.cross(Vector((0, 0, 1)))
        side = side.normalized() if side.length > 1e-4 else Vector((1, 0, 0))
        pt = info.cam_loc + info.cam_fwd * d + side * rnd.uniform(-0.6, 0.6) * d
        pt.z = info.ground_z + rnd.uniform(0.1, 1.5)
        # _blocked skips the kit's own objects: the fog box made just before would otherwise block every ray
        hits += 1 if _blocked(scene, dg, pt + s * 0.03, s) else 0
    return hits / n


# ---------------- rain / snow ----------------

def precip(scene, info, p):
    kind = p["precip"]
    if kind == "none":
        return {}
    cam = info.camera
    near, far = 0.3, min(max(info.depth, 6.0), p["precip_reach"])
    corners = []
    # cover the whole camera move: frustum corners at several frames of the scene's range
    keep = scene.frame_current
    fs, fe = scene.frame_start, scene.frame_end
    frames = sorted({fs, (fs + fe) // 2, fe, keep, fs + (fe - fs) // 4, fs + 3 * (fe - fs) // 4})
    for f in frames:
        scene.frame_set(f)
        mw = cam.matrix_world.copy()
        loc = mw.translation
        fwd = (mw.to_quaternion() @ Vector((0, 0, -1))).normalized()
        for v in cam.data.view_frame(scene=scene):
            ray = ((mw @ v) - loc).normalized()
            for d in (near, far):
                corners.append(loc + ray * (d / max(ray.dot(fwd), 0.1)))
        corners.append(loc.copy())
    scene.frame_set(keep)
    lo = Vector((min(c.x for c in corners), min(c.y for c in corners), info.ground_z - 0.05))
    hi_ = Vector((max(c.x for c in corners), max(c.y for c in corners), max(c.z for c in corners) + 2.0))
    vol = (hi_.x - lo.x) * (hi_.y - lo.y) * (hi_.z - lo.z)
    snow = kind in ("snow", "dust")
    dust = kind == "dust"
    if dust:  # motes hang in the light around the subject, not in front of the lens
        c, r = info.subject_center, max(info.subject_dist * 0.8, info.subject_size)
        lo = Vector((min(lo.x, c.x - r), min(lo.y, c.y - r), info.ground_z))
        hi_ = Vector((max(hi_.x, c.x + r), max(hi_.y, c.y + r), info.ground_z + max(info.cam_loc.z - info.ground_z, 1.5) * 2))
    # drops a camera can resolve: a fixed budget in the box near the lens (fog/haze carries the far rain)
    moves = len(frames) > 1 and (hi_ - lo).length > 0
    area_scale = max(1.0, ((hi_.x - lo.x) * (hi_.y - lo.y)) / max(far * far * 1.2, 1.0)) ** 0.5 if moves else 1.0
    count = int((4000 if dust else 12000 if snow else 30000) * p["precip_amount"] * min(area_scale, 4.0))
    ob = new_object(scene, "Look Kit " + kind.title(), bpy.data.meshes.new("Look Kit " + kind.title()), "precip")
    ob.visible_shadow = False  # 30k streaks in every practical's shadow map cost more than the whole frame
    mod = ob.modifiers.new("Look Kit Precip", "NODES")
    mod.node_group = library.ensure("LK Precip")
    mat = library.ensure("LK Snow" if snow else "LK Rain")
    if dust:
        mat = mat.copy()
        tag(mat, "precip")
    srf = mat.node_tree.nodes["LK Rain Surface"]
    sock(srf, "Emission Strength").default_value = 0.0 if dust else p["precip_glow"]
    scale_ref = max(info.subject_dist, 1.0)
    # close product shots: drops shrink with the shot so streaks don't become poles across the lens
    k = min(max(info.subject_dist / 5.0, 0.12), 1.0) if info.hero else min((scale_ref / 5) ** 0.5, 1.6)
    width = (0.0012 if dust else 0.0035 if snow else 0.0011) * k
    _set_mod(mod, Min=lo, Max=hi_, Count=count, Speed=0.03 if dust else 1.1 if snow else 9.0,
             Length=0.0 if snow else p["rain_length"] * (k if info.hero else 1.0), Width=width,
             Wind=(0.02, 0.01, 0) if dust else tuple(p["wind"]), Drift=0.15 if dust else 0.6 if snow else 0.0,
             Snow=snow, Material=mat, Seed=3)
    out = {"precip": kind, "drops": count}
    if not snow and p["splashes"] > 0:
        ref = bpy.data.collections.get("Look Kit Splash Targets")
        if ref is None:
            ref = tag(bpy.data.collections.new("Look Kit Splash Targets"), "precip")  # not linked to the scene
        for o in list(ref.objects):
            ref.objects.unlink(o)
        for o in info.meshes:
            if o.name not in ref.objects:
                ref.objects.link(o)
        sob = new_object(scene, "Look Kit Splashes", bpy.data.meshes.new("Look Kit Splashes"), "precip")
        sob.visible_shadow = False
        smod = sob.modifiers.new("Look Kit Splash", "NODES")
        smod.node_group = library.ensure("LK Splash")
        area = (hi_.x - lo.x) * (hi_.y - lo.y)
        sc = int(area * 8 * p["splashes"] * p["precip_amount"])
        _set_mod(smod, Target=ref, Min=lo, Max=hi_, Count=sc, Rate=2.5, Size=0.03 * k,
                 Material=library.ensure("LK Splash Drop"), Seed=5)
        out["splashes"] = sc
    return out


def _set_mod(mod, **vals):
    """Blender 5.2 keeps geometry-nodes modifier inputs at mod.properties.inputs.<identifier>.value."""
    items = {it.name: it.identifier for it in mod.node_group.interface.items_tree if getattr(it, "in_out", "") == "INPUT"}
    ins = mod.properties.inputs
    for k, v in vals.items():
        getattr(ins, items[k]).value = tuple(v) if isinstance(v, Vector) else v


# ---------------- wet surfaces ----------------

WET_NODE = "LK Wet"


def wet(scene, info, p):
    if p["wetness"] <= 0 and p["puddles"] <= 0:
        return {}
    group = library.ensure("LK Wet")
    done = 0
    seen = set()
    for ob in info.meshes:
        for slot in ob.material_slots:
            m = slot.material
            if m is None or m.name in seen or not m.use_nodes or tagged(m):
                continue
            seen.add(m.name)
            if _emissive_only(m):
                continue
            done += _inject_wet(m, group, p)
    return {"wet_materials": done}


def _emissive_only(m):
    return not any(n.type == "BSDF_PRINCIPLED" for n in m.node_tree.nodes)


def _inject_wet(m, group, p):
    T = Tree(m.node_tree)
    n = 0
    for bsdf in [x for x in T.n if x.type == "BSDF_PRINCIPLED"]:
        if any(l.from_node.name.startswith(WET_NODE) for l in bsdf.inputs["Base Color"].links):
            continue
        g = T.node("ShaderNodeGroup", bsdf.location.x - 250, bsdf.location.y + 150)
        g.node_tree = group
        g.name = g.label = WET_NODE
        g["look_kit"] = "wet"
        g.hide = True
        for name in ("Base Color", "Roughness", "Normal"):
            src = bsdf.inputs[name]
            gin = sock(g, {"Base Color": "Color"}.get(name, name))
            if src.is_linked:
                T.l.new(src.links[0].from_socket, gin)
            elif name == "Normal":
                geo = T.node("ShaderNodeNewGeometry", g.location.x - 200, g.location.y - 200)
                geo.name = geo.label = WET_NODE + " Normal"
                geo["look_kit"] = "wet"
                geo.hide = True
                T.link(geo, "Normal", g, "Normal")
            else:
                gin.default_value = src.default_value
            T.l.new(sock(g, {"Base Color": "Color"}.get(name, name), True), src)
        T.set(g, Wetness=p["wetness"], Puddles=p["puddles"], Puddle_Scale=p["puddle_scale"] or 3.0,
              Ripples=1.0 if p["precip"] == "rain" else 0.0)
        time_driver(sock(g, "Time"))
        n += 1
    return n


def remove_wet():
    for m in bpy.data.materials:
        if not m.use_nodes or m.node_tree is None:
            continue
        T = m.node_tree
        for g in [x for x in T.nodes if x.get("look_kit") == "wet" and x.type == "GROUP"]:
            for out_name, in_name in (("Color", "Color"), ("Roughness", "Roughness"), ("Normal", "Normal")):
                gin, gout = sock(g, in_name), sock(g, out_name, True)
                for l in list(gout.links):
                    dst = l.to_socket
                    if gin.is_linked and gin.links[0].from_node.get("look_kit") != "wet":
                        T.links.new(gin.links[0].from_socket, dst)
                    elif not gin.is_linked:
                        dst.default_value = gin.default_value
                    else:
                        T.links.remove(l)
            ad = T.animation_data
            if ad is not None:
                for fc in [f for f in ad.drivers if f'nodes["{g.name}"]' in f.data_path]:
                    ad.drivers.remove(fc)
            T.nodes.remove(g)
        for x in [x for x in T.nodes if x.get("look_kit") == "wet"]:
            T.nodes.remove(x)


# ---------------- hero key / rim ----------------

def hero_light(scene, info, p):
    """A product-scale hero in a dark look (night street, neon room) gets a soft key from the camera side and a
    rim from behind in the look's colours, sized to it, so it separates from the background."""
    if p["hero_light"] <= 0 or not info.hero or p["studio"]:
        return {}
    c = info.subject_center
    size = max(info.subject_size, 0.05)
    d = max(size * 2.5, 0.3)
    side = info.cam_fwd.cross(Vector((0, 0, 1)))
    side = side.normalized() if side.length > 1e-4 else Vector((1, 0, 0))
    # key near neutral so the product keeps its own colour; the rim carries the look's colour
    rig = (("Look Kit Hero Key", c - info.cam_fwd * d + side * d * 0.7 + Vector((0, 0, d * 0.5)), 1.0, 4300.0, 1.2),
           ("Look Kit Hero Rim", c + info.cam_fwd * d * 0.9 - side * d * 0.6 + Vector((0, 0, d * 0.4)), 2.5, p["rim_kelvin"], 0.5))
    for name, loc, share, k, sz in rig:
        dist = (loc - c).length
        if "Key" in name:  # a tight spot: lights the hero, not the backdrop behind it
            ld = bpy.data.lights.new(name, "SPOT")
            ld.spot_size = min(2 * math.atan(size * 0.75 / dist) * 1.2, math.radians(120))
            ld.spot_blend = 0.35
            ld.shadow_soft_size = size * 0.3
            ld.energy = p["hero_light"] * share * 4.0 * dist ** 2 * 4 * math.pi / (2 * math.pi * (1 - math.cos(ld.spot_size / 2)))
        else:
            ld = bpy.data.lights.new(name, "AREA")
            ld.shape = "RECTANGLE"
            ld.size, ld.size_y = size * sz, size * sz * 1.6
            ld.energy = p["hero_light"] * share * 4.0 * dist ** 2
        ld.color = kelvin(k)
        ld.volume_factor = 0.3
        ob = new_object(scene, name, ld, "practicals")
        ob.location = loc
        ob.rotation_euler = (c - loc).to_track_quat("-Z", "Y").to_euler()
    return {"hero_lights": 2}


# ---------------- studio rig ----------------

def studio(scene, info, p):
    if not p["studio"]:
        return {}
    c = info.subject_center
    size = max(info.subject_size, 0.05)
    d = max(info.subject_dist * 0.8, size * 2.5)
    side = info.cam_fwd.cross(Vector((0, 0, 1)))
    side = side.normalized() if side.length > 1e-4 else Vector((1, 0, 0))
    back = info.cam_fwd
    rig = [  # name, position, softbox size factor, share of key, kelvin
        ("Look Kit Key", c - back * d * 0.6 + side * d * 0.8 + Vector((0, 0, d * 0.7)), 1.6, 1.0, 5200),
        ("Look Kit Fill", c - back * d * 0.9 - side * d * 0.9 + Vector((0, 0, d * 0.2)), 2.2, p["fill"], 6000),
        ("Look Kit Rim L", c + back * d * 0.8 + side * d * 0.6 + Vector((0, 0, d * 0.5)), 0.5, p["rim"], 6500),
        ("Look Kit Rim R", c + back * d * 0.8 - side * d * 0.6 + Vector((0, 0, d * 0.4)), 0.5, p["rim"] * 0.8, 6500),
        ("Look Kit Top", c + Vector((0, 0, d * 1.1)), 2.5, p["top"], 5600),
    ]
    for name, loc, sz, share, k in rig:
        if share <= 0:
            continue
        ld = bpy.data.lights.new(name, "AREA")
        ld.shape = "RECTANGLE"
        ld.size, ld.size_y = size * sz * (2.5 if "Rim" in name else 1.0) * 0.6, size * sz * (4 if "Rim" in name else 1.0)
        dist = (loc - c).length
        ld.energy = p["key_power"] * share * dist ** 2 * 6
        ld.color = kelvin(k)
        ob = new_object(scene, name, ld, "studio")
        ob.location = loc
        ob.rotation_euler = (c - loc).to_track_quat("-Z", "Y").to_euler()
    made_backdrop = False
    want = p["backdrop"]
    if want == "on" or (want == "auto" and not info.ground):
        _backdrop(scene, info, size)
        made_backdrop = True
    return {"studio_lights": len([r for r in rig if r[3] > 0]), "backdrop": made_backdrop}


def _backdrop(scene, info, size):
    """A seamless curved sweep behind and under the subject."""
    import bmesh
    me = bpy.data.meshes.new("Look Kit Backdrop")
    bm = bmesh.new()
    w = max(size * 8, info.subject_dist * 2.5)
    r = w * 0.25
    pts = [(-w, 0.0)]
    for i in range(9):
        a = i / 8 * math.pi / 2
        pts.append((w * 0.4 + math.sin(a) * r, r - math.cos(a) * r))
    pts.append((w * 0.4 + r, w * 1.2))
    rows = []
    for x in (-w, w):
        rows.append([bm.verts.new((x, py, pz)) for py, pz in pts])
    for i in range(len(pts) - 1):
        bm.faces.new((rows[0][i], rows[1][i], rows[1][i + 1], rows[0][i + 1]))
    bm.to_mesh(me)
    bm.free()
    for poly in me.polygons:
        poly.use_smooth = True
    ob = new_object(scene, "Look Kit Backdrop", me, "studio")
    f = Vector((info.cam_fwd.x, info.cam_fwd.y, 0)).normalized()
    ob.rotation_euler = (0, 0, math.atan2(-f.x, f.y))
    ob.location = Vector((info.subject_center.x, info.subject_center.y, info.lo.z)) - f * (w * 0.4 - info.subject_size)
    mat = tag(bpy.data.materials.new("Look Kit Backdrop"), "studio")
    mat.use_nodes = True
    pb = mat.node_tree.nodes.get("Principled BSDF")
    pb.inputs["Base Color"].default_value = (0.18, 0.18, 0.19, 1)
    pb.inputs["Roughness"].default_value = 0.55
    me.materials.append(mat)

def droplets(scene, info, p):
    if p["droplets"] <= 0 or info.subject is None:
        return {}
    ob = new_object(scene, "Look Kit Droplets", bpy.data.meshes.new("Look Kit Droplets"), "droplets")
    mod = ob.modifiers.new("Look Kit Droplets", "NODES")

    size = info.subject_size
    r = p["droplet_size"] or min(max(size * 0.015, 0.0008), 0.004)  # real beads: ~1-4 mm whatever the product
    _set_mod(mod, Target=info.subject, Density=p["droplets"] * 0.12 / (math.pi * r * r), Size=r, Material=library.ensure("LK Droplet"), Seed=3)
    return {"droplets_on": info.subject.name}

WATER_NAMES = re.compile(r"water|lake|\bsea\b|ocean|pond|river|reservoir", re.I)


def calm_water(scene, info, p):
    """Still water mirrors the sky and the far shore: on water-named objects (or a flat ground sheet named so) set the
    Principled roughness to `calm_water` (restored by remove). Linked roughness (textures) is left alone."""
    r = p["calm_water"]
    if r < 0:
        return {}
    st = state(scene)
    saved = st.setdefault("water_rough", {})
    done = []
    for ob in info.meshes:
        if not WATER_NAMES.search(ob.name):
            continue
        for slot in ob.material_slots:
            m = slot.material
            if m is None or not m.use_nodes:
                continue
            for n in m.node_tree.nodes:
                if n.type == "BSDF_PRINCIPLED" and not n.inputs["Roughness"].is_linked:
                    saved.setdefault(m.name, {}).setdefault(n.name, n.inputs["Roughness"].default_value)
                    n.inputs["Roughness"].default_value = r
                    done.append(m.name)
    save_state(scene, st)
    return {"calm_water": sorted(set(done))} if done else {}

"""Node groups and materials the looks share. `ensure(name)` returns the datablock: already in the file, else
appended from library.blend (written by build_library.py from these same builders), else built here."""
import os

import bpy

from .core import TAG, tag
from .nodes import Tree, group_io, sock

VERSION = 10  # bump when a builder changes; stale copies in a scene are rebuilt
LIBRARY = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)), "library.blend")
GROUPS = ("LK Wet", "LK Height Fog", "LK Precip", "LK Splash", "LK Droplets", "LK Gobo Mask")
MATERIALS = ("LK Rain", "LK Snow", "LK Splash Drop", "LK Droplet", "LK Gobo", "LK Bulb")


def _fresh(idb):
    return idb is not None and idb.get("look_kit_version") == VERSION


def ensure(name):
    coll = bpy.data.node_groups if name in GROUPS else bpy.data.materials
    have = coll.get(name)
    if _fresh(have):
        return have
    if have is not None:
        have.name = name + " (old)"
    if os.path.exists(LIBRARY):
        attr = "node_groups" if name in GROUPS else "materials"
        with bpy.data.libraries.load(LIBRARY, link=False) as (src, dst):
            if name in getattr(src, attr):
                setattr(dst, attr, [name])
        got = coll.get(name)
        if _fresh(got):
            _replace(have, got)
            return got
        if got is not None:
            coll.remove(got)
    built = BUILDERS[name]()
    built["look_kit_version"] = VERSION
    tag(built, "library")
    _replace(have, built)
    return built


def _replace(old, new):
    if old is not None and old != new:
        old.user_remap(new)
        (bpy.data.node_groups if isinstance(old, bpy.types.NodeTree) else bpy.data.materials).remove(old)


def _new_group(name, kind):
    ng = bpy.data.node_groups.new(name, kind)
    return ng, Tree(ng)


# ---------------- shader groups ----------------

def build_wet():
    """Wet surface on top of any material: darkens, sharpens reflections, adds puddles on upward faces with
    animated rain ripples. World-space position, so no UVs needed."""
    ng, T = _new_group("LK Wet", "ShaderNodeTree")
    group_io(ng, [
        ("Color", "NodeSocketColor", (0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 1)), ("Roughness", "NodeSocketFloat", 0.5, 0, 1),
        ("Normal", "NodeSocketVector", None), ("Wetness", "NodeSocketFloat", 0.8, 0, 1),
        ("Puddles", "NodeSocketFloat", 0.4, 0, 1), ("Puddle Scale", "NodeSocketFloat", 3.0, 0.01, 1000),
        ("Ripples", "NodeSocketFloat", 1.0, 0, 1), ("Time", "NodeSocketFloat", 0.0),
        ("Darken", "NodeSocketFloat", 0.5, 0, 1),
    ], [("Color", "NodeSocketColor"), ("Roughness", "NodeSocketFloat"), ("Normal", "NodeSocketVector"),
        ("Puddle", "NodeSocketFloat")])
    gi = T.node("NodeGroupInput", -1200, 0)
    go = T.node("NodeGroupOutput", 900, 0)
    geo = T.node("ShaderNodeNewGeometry", -1200, -400)
    nz = T.node("ShaderNodeSeparateXYZ", -1000, -400)
    T.link(geo, "Normal", nz, "Vector")
    up = T.map_range(sock(nz, "Z", True), 0.55, 0.95, 0, 1, -800, -400, interp="SMOOTHSTEP")
    # puddle mask: large noise thresholded by the Puddles amount
    inv = T.math("DIVIDE", 1.0, sock(gi, "Puddle Scale", True), -1000, -650)
    noise = T.node("ShaderNodeTexNoise", -800, -650, in_Detail=3.0, in_Roughness=0.55)
    noise.noise_dimensions = "3D"
    T.link(geo, "Position", noise, "Vector")
    T.l.new(inv, sock(noise, "Scale"))
    thr = T.map_range(sock(gi, "Puddles", True), 0, 1, 0.68, 0.38, -800, -900)
    thr_hi = T.math("ADD", thr, 0.03, -600, -900)
    puddle_raw = T.map_range(sock(noise, "Factor", True), thr, thr_hi, 0, 1, -500, -650, interp="SMOOTHSTEP")
    puddle = T.math("MULTIPLY", puddle_raw, up, -300, -650)
    pud_on = T.math("GREATER_THAN", sock(gi, "Puddles", True), 0.001, -300, -850)
    puddle = T.math("MULTIPLY", puddle, pud_on, -150, -700)
    # wetness everywhere, stronger on surfaces facing the sky, broken up a little
    n2 = T.node("ShaderNodeTexNoise", -800, 300, in_Scale=0.7, in_Detail=2.0)
    T.link(geo, "Position", n2, "Vector")
    patch = T.map_range(sock(n2, "Factor", True), 0.3, 0.7, 0.75, 1.0, -600, 300)
    upw = T.map_range(up, 0, 1, 0.55, 1.0, -600, 100)
    wet = T.math("MULTIPLY", T.math("MULTIPLY", sock(gi, "Wetness", True), patch, -400, 250), upw, -250, 200)
    # colour: wet porous surfaces darken; water in puddles darkens more
    dark = T.math("MULTIPLY", wet, sock(gi, "Darken", True), -100, 300)
    keep = T.map_range(dark, 0, 1, 1.0, 0.45, 50, 300)
    comb = T.node("ShaderNodeCombineColor", 100, 450)
    for ch in ("Red", "Green", "Blue"):
        T.l.new(keep, sock(comb, ch))
    col_wet = T.mix("RGBA", 1.0, sock(gi, "Color", True), sock(comb, "Color", True), 250, 300, blend="MULTIPLY")
    col_pud = T.mix("RGBA", 1.0, col_wet, (0.55, 0.55, 0.55, 1), 450, 450, blend="MULTIPLY")
    col = T.mix("RGBA", puddle, col_wet, col_pud, 650, 300)
    T.l.new(col, sock(go, "Color"))
    # roughness
    r_wet = T.mix("FLOAT", wet, sock(gi, "Roughness", True), T.math("MULTIPLY", sock(gi, "Roughness", True), 0.3, 250, 50), 450, 50)
    r = T.mix("FLOAT", puddle, r_wet, 0.03, 650, 50)
    T.l.new(r, sock(go, "Roughness"))
    # normal: puddles go flat, with animated ripples
    rn = T.node("ShaderNodeTexNoise", -300, -1100, in_Scale=18.0, in_Detail=1.0)
    rn.noise_dimensions = "4D"
    T.link(geo, "Position", rn, "Vector")
    w = T.math("MULTIPLY", sock(gi, "Time", True), 1.7, -500, -1200)
    T.l.new(w, sock(rn, "W"))
    rstr = T.math("MULTIPLY", sock(gi, "Ripples", True), 0.12, -300, -1300)
    bump = T.node("ShaderNodeBump", 0, -1100, in_Distance=0.004)
    T.l.new(rstr, sock(bump, "Strength"))
    T.link(rn, "Factor", bump, "Height")
    T.link(geo, "Normal", bump, "Normal")
    nmix = T.mix("VECTOR", puddle, sock(gi, "Normal", True), sock(bump, "Normal", True), 300, -900)
    nn = T.vmath("NORMALIZE", nmix, None, 500, -900)
    T.l.new(nn, sock(go, "Normal"))
    T.l.new(puddle, sock(go, "Puddle"))
    return ng


def build_height_fog():
    ng, T = _new_group("LK Height Fog", "ShaderNodeTree")
    group_io(ng, [
        ("Density", "NodeSocketFloat", 0.05, 0, 100), ("Ground", "NodeSocketFloat", 0.0),
        ("Height", "NodeSocketFloat", 3.0, 0.001, 1e4), ("Haze", "NodeSocketFloat", 0.15, 0, 10),
        ("Noise Scale", "NodeSocketFloat", 0.15, 0, 100), ("Noise", "NodeSocketFloat", 0.5, 0, 1),
        ("Color", "NodeSocketColor", (0.9, 0.92, 0.95, 1)), ("Anisotropy", "NodeSocketFloat", 0.5, -1, 1),
        ("Time", "NodeSocketFloat", 0.0), ("Drift", "NodeSocketFloat", 0.3),
    ], [("Volume", "NodeSocketShader")])
    gi = T.node("NodeGroupInput", -1000, 0)
    go = T.node("NodeGroupOutput", 600, 0)
    geo = T.node("ShaderNodeNewGeometry", -1000, -300)
    sz = T.node("ShaderNodeSeparateXYZ", -800, -300)
    T.link(geo, "Position", sz, "Vector")
    h = T.math("DIVIDE", T.math("SUBTRACT", sock(sz, "Z", True), sock(gi, "Ground", True), -650, -300),
               sock(gi, "Height", True), -500, -300)
    h = T.math("MAXIMUM", h, 0.0, -350, -300)
    fall = T.math("EXPONENT", T.math("MULTIPLY", h, -1.0, -250, -300), None, -100, -300)
    noise = T.node("ShaderNodeTexNoise", -500, -600, in_Detail=2.0)
    noise.noise_dimensions = "4D"
    T.link(geo, "Position", noise, "Vector")
    T.link(gi, "Noise Scale", noise, "Scale")
    T.l.new(T.math("MULTIPLY", sock(gi, "Time", True), sock(gi, "Drift", True), -700, -700), sock(noise, "W"))
    nf = T.map_range(sock(noise, "Factor", True), 0.3, 0.7, 0.0, 2.0, -300, -600)
    nmix = T.mix("FLOAT", sock(gi, "Noise", True), 1.0, nf, -100, -600)
    # haze thins out four times slower than the fog, so the air above a canopy or roof doesn't glow evenly
    haze_fall = T.math("EXPONENT", T.math("MULTIPLY", h, -0.25, -250, -450), None, -100, -450)
    haze = T.math("MULTIPLY", sock(gi, "Haze", True), haze_fall, 50, -500)
    d = T.math("ADD", T.math("MULTIPLY", fall, nmix, 50, -400), haze, 200, -400)
    d = T.math("MULTIPLY", d, sock(gi, "Density", True), 350, -400)
    vol = T.node("ShaderNodeVolumePrincipled", 400, 0)
    T.link(gi, "Color", vol, "Color")
    T.link(gi, "Anisotropy", vol, "Anisotropy")
    T.l.new(d, sock(vol, "Density"))
    T.link(vol, "Volume", go, "Volume")
    return ng


def build_gobo_mask():
    """Alpha mask for a light blocker (gobo): 0 leaves dappled canopy, 1 window panes, 2 blinds, 3 broken roof."""
    ng, T = _new_group("LK Gobo Mask", "ShaderNodeTree")
    group_io(ng, [("Pattern", "NodeSocketInt", 0, 0, 3), ("Scale", "NodeSocketFloat", 1.0, 0.001, 1000),
                  ("Openness", "NodeSocketFloat", 0.4, 0, 1)], [("Blocked", "NodeSocketFloat")])
    gi = T.node("NodeGroupInput", -900, 0)
    go = T.node("NodeGroupOutput", 700, 0)
    tc = T.node("ShaderNodeTexCoord", -900, -300)
    sc = T.vmath("DIVIDE", sock(tc, "Object", True), None, -700, -300)
    cs = T.node("ShaderNodeCombineXYZ", -900, -500)
    for a in "XYZ":
        T.link(gi, "Scale", cs, a)
    T.l.new(sock(cs, "Vector", True), sc.node.inputs[1])
    # leaves: voronoi + noise blobs
    vor = T.node("ShaderNodeTexVoronoi", -500, 200, in_Scale=3.0, in_Randomness=1.0)
    T.l.new(sc, sock(vor, "Vector"))
    nz = T.node("ShaderNodeTexNoise", -500, 0, in_Scale=2.0, in_Detail=6.0)
    T.l.new(sc, sock(nz, "Vector"))
    leaf = T.math("ADD", sock(vor, "Distance", True), T.math("MULTIPLY", sock(nz, "Factor", True), 0.6, -300, 0), -250, 150)
    thr = T.map_range(sock(gi, "Openness", True), 0, 1, 1.05, 0.45, -300, 300)  # open = fewer leaves
    leaves = T.math("SUBTRACT", 1.0, T.math("GREATER_THAN", leaf, thr, -100, 250), 0, 200)
    # window panes: grid of bars
    sep = T.node("ShaderNodeSeparateXYZ", -500, -300)
    T.l.new(sc, sock(sep, "Vector"))
    fx = T.math("FRACT", T.math("MULTIPLY", sock(sep, "X", True), 4.0, -350, -300), None, -250, -300)
    fy = T.math("FRACT", T.math("MULTIPLY", sock(sep, "Y", True), 3.0, -350, -400), None, -250, -400)
    bw = T.map_range(sock(gi, "Openness", True), 0, 1, 0.3, 0.04, -350, -500)
    bx = T.math("LESS_THAN", fx, bw, -100, -300)
    by = T.math("LESS_THAN", fy, bw, -100, -400)
    frame = T.math("MAXIMUM", bx, by, 50, -350)
    # blinds: horizontal slats
    fb = T.math("FRACT", T.math("MULTIPLY", sock(sep, "Y", True), 14.0, -350, -600), None, -250, -600)
    slat = T.math("GREATER_THAN", fb, sock(gi, "Openness", True), -100, -600)
    # broken roof: mostly blocked, a few ragged holes
    vor2 = T.node("ShaderNodeTexVoronoi", -500, -800, in_Scale=1.5, in_Randomness=1.0)
    vor2.feature = "F1"
    T.l.new(sc, sock(vor2, "Vector"))
    n3 = T.node("ShaderNodeTexNoise", -500, -1000, in_Scale=6.0, in_Detail=8.0)
    T.l.new(sc, sock(n3, "Vector"))
    rag = T.math("ADD", sock(vor2, "Distance", True), T.math("MULTIPLY", sock(n3, "Factor", True), 0.25, -300, -1000), -250, -850)
    hole = T.math("LESS_THAN", rag, T.math("MULTIPLY", sock(gi, "Openness", True), 0.55, -300, -1100), -100, -850)
    roof = T.math("SUBTRACT", 1.0, hole, 50, -850)
    # pick by pattern index
    p = sock(gi, "Pattern", True)
    out = leaves
    for idx, val in ((1, frame), (2, slat), (3, roof)):
        is_p = T.math("COMPARE", p, float(idx), 250, -200 * idx)
        is_p.node.inputs[2].default_value = 0.1
        out = T.mix("FLOAT", is_p, out, val, 450, -200 * idx)
    T.l.new(out, sock(go, "Blocked"))
    return ng


# ---------------- geometry-node groups ----------------

def _gn(name):
    ng, T = _new_group(name, "GeometryNodeTree")
    ng.is_modifier = True
    return ng, T


def _rand(T, dtype, mn, mx, seed, x=0, y=0, id_sock=None):
    n = T.node("FunctionNodeRandomValue", x, y, data_type=dtype)
    for k, v in (("Min", mn), ("Max", mx)):
        s = sock(n, k)
        if isinstance(v, (int, float, tuple)):
            s.default_value = v
        else:
            T.l.new(v, s)
    if seed is not None:
        if isinstance(seed, int):
            sock(n, "Seed").default_value = seed
        else:
            T.l.new(seed, sock(n, "Seed"))
    if id_sock is not None:
        T.l.new(id_sock, sock(n, "ID"))
    return sock(n, "Value", True)


def build_precip():
    """Falling rain streaks or snow flakes filling a box, looping with scene time (so any frame is valid)."""
    ng, T = _gn("LK Precip")
    group_io(ng, [
        ("Geometry", "NodeSocketGeometry", None),
        ("Min", "NodeSocketVector", (-10, -10, 0)), ("Max", "NodeSocketVector", (10, 10, 8)),
        ("Count", "NodeSocketInt", 20000, 0, 10**8), ("Speed", "NodeSocketFloat", 8.0, 0, 100),
        ("Length", "NodeSocketFloat", 0.35, 0, 10), ("Width", "NodeSocketFloat", 0.0012, 0, 1),
        ("Wind", "NodeSocketVector", (0.6, 0.2, 0)), ("Drift", "NodeSocketFloat", 0.0, 0, 10),
        ("Snow", "NodeSocketBool", False), ("Material", "NodeSocketMaterial", None),
        ("Seed", "NodeSocketInt", 0, 0, 10**6),
    ], [("Geometry", "NodeSocketGeometry")])
    gi = T.node("NodeGroupInput", -1600, 0)
    go = T.node("NodeGroupOutput", 1200, 0)
    st = T.node("GeometryNodeInputSceneTime", -1600, -500)
    seed = sock(gi, "Seed", True)
    pos0 = _rand(T, "FLOAT_VECTOR", sock(gi, "Min", True), sock(gi, "Max", True), seed, -1300, 200)
    pts = T.node("GeometryNodePoints", -1100, 200)
    T.link(gi, "Count", pts, "Count")
    T.l.new(pos0, sock(pts, "Position"))
    # animate: fall at Speed, slide with Wind, optional drift noise; wrap inside the box
    t = sock(st, "Seconds", True)
    p = T.node("GeometryNodeInputPosition", -1300, -200)
    off = T.node("ShaderNodeCombineXYZ", -1100, -400)
    wind = T.node("ShaderNodeSeparateXYZ", -1300, -400)
    T.link(gi, "Wind", wind, "Vector")
    T.l.new(T.math("MULTIPLY", sock(wind, "X", True), t, -1150, -350), sock(off, "X"))
    T.l.new(T.math("MULTIPLY", sock(wind, "Y", True), t, -1150, -450), sock(off, "Y"))
    T.l.new(T.math("MULTIPLY", T.math("MULTIPLY", sock(gi, "Speed", True), t, -1250, -550), -1.0, -1150, -550), sock(off, "Z"))
    moved = T.vmath("ADD", sock(p, "Position", True), sock(off, "Vector", True), -900, -300)
    dn = T.node("ShaderNodeTexNoise", -900, -600, in_Scale=0.35, in_Detail=1.0)
    dn.noise_dimensions = "4D"
    T.link(p, "Position", dn, "Vector")
    T.l.new(T.math("MULTIPLY", t, 0.25, -1000, -700), sock(dn, "W"))
    dv = T.vmath("SUBTRACT", sock(dn, "Color", True), (0.5, 0.5, 0.5), -700, -600)
    dv = T.vmath("MULTIPLY", dv, (2, 2, 0.4), -550, -600)
    dv = T.vmath("SCALE", dv, None, -400, -600, scale=sock(gi, "Drift", True))
    moved = T.vmath("ADD", moved, dv, -250, -400)
    wrapped = T.node("ShaderNodeVectorMath", -50, -300, operation="WRAP")
    T.l.new(moved, wrapped.inputs[0])
    T.link(gi, "Max", wrapped, 1)
    T.link(gi, "Min", wrapped, 2)
    setp = T.node("GeometryNodeSetPosition", 150, 200)
    T.link(pts, "Points", setp, "Geometry")
    T.link(wrapped, "Vector", setp, "Position")
    # the drop: a thin 3-sided streak (rain) or a small flake (snow)
    cyl = T.node("GeometryNodeMeshCylinder", -300, 600, in_Vertices=3, fill_type="NONE")
    T.link(gi, "Width", cyl, "Radius")
    T.link(gi, "Length", cyl, "Depth")
    flake = T.node("GeometryNodeMeshIcoSphere", -300, 850, in_Subdivisions=1)
    T.link(gi, "Width", flake, "Radius")
    sw = T.node("GeometryNodeSwitch", -50, 700, input_type="GEOMETRY")
    T.link(gi, "Snow", sw, "Switch")
    T.link(cyl, "Mesh", sw, "False")
    T.link(flake, "Mesh", sw, "True")
    mat = T.node("GeometryNodeSetMaterial", 150, 700)
    T.link(sw, "Output", mat, "Geometry")
    T.link(gi, "Material", mat, "Material")
    dirv = T.node("ShaderNodeCombineXYZ", -50, 450)
    T.l.new(sock(wind, "X", True), sock(dirv, "X"))
    T.l.new(sock(wind, "Y", True), sock(dirv, "Y"))
    T.l.new(T.math("MULTIPLY", sock(gi, "Speed", True), -1.0, -200, 400), sock(dirv, "Z"))
    align = T.node("FunctionNodeAlignRotationToVector", 150, 450, axis="Z")
    T.link(dirv, "Vector", align, "Vector")
    sc = _rand(T, "FLOAT", 0.55, 1.45, 7, 150, 300)
    inst = T.node("GeometryNodeInstanceOnPoints", 450, 200)
    T.link(setp, "Geometry", inst, "Points")
    T.link(mat, "Geometry", inst, "Instance")
    T.link(align, "Rotation", inst, "Rotation")
    T.l.new(sc, sock(inst, "Scale"))
    T.link(inst, "Instances", go, "Geometry")
    return ng


def build_splash():
    """Rain splashes: little crowns flicking on whatever surfaces lie under the rain box (ray cast onto the
    Target collection, so curbs, roofs and cars all get them)."""
    ng, T = _gn("LK Splash")
    group_io(ng, [
        ("Geometry", "NodeSocketGeometry", None), ("Target", "NodeSocketCollection", None),
        ("Min", "NodeSocketVector", (-10, -10, 0)), ("Max", "NodeSocketVector", (10, 10, 8)),
        ("Count", "NodeSocketInt", 3000, 0, 10**7), ("Rate", "NodeSocketFloat", 2.5, 0, 100),
        ("Size", "NodeSocketFloat", 0.035, 0, 10), ("Material", "NodeSocketMaterial", None),
        ("Seed", "NodeSocketInt", 1, 0, 10**6),
    ], [("Geometry", "NodeSocketGeometry")])
    gi = T.node("NodeGroupInput", -1600, 0)
    go = T.node("NodeGroupOutput", 1200, 0)
    st = T.node("GeometryNodeInputSceneTime", -1600, -500)
    pos0 = _rand(T, "FLOAT_VECTOR", sock(gi, "Min", True), sock(gi, "Max", True), sock(gi, "Seed", True), -1300, 200)
    sep = T.node("ShaderNodeSeparateXYZ", -1300, -100)
    T.link(gi, "Max", sep, "Vector")
    sep0 = T.node("ShaderNodeSeparateXYZ", -1150, 200)
    T.l.new(pos0, sock(sep0, "Vector"))
    top = T.node("ShaderNodeCombineXYZ", -1000, 200)
    T.link(sep0, "X", top, "X")
    T.link(sep0, "Y", top, "Y")
    T.link(sep, "Z", top, "Z")
    pts = T.node("GeometryNodePoints", -850, 200)
    T.link(gi, "Count", pts, "Count")
    T.link(top, "Vector", pts, "Position")
    ci = T.node("GeometryNodeCollectionInfo", -1100, -300, transform_space="RELATIVE")
    T.link(gi, "Target", ci, "Collection")
    real = T.node("GeometryNodeRealizeInstances", -900, -300)
    T.link(ci, "Instances", real, "Geometry")
    rc = T.node("GeometryNodeRaycast", -650, -100, in_Ray_Direction=(0, 0, -1), in_Ray_Length=1000.0)
    T.link(real, "Geometry", rc, "Target Geometry")
    dele = T.node("GeometryNodeDeleteGeometry", -400, 200)
    T.link(pts, "Points", dele, "Geometry")
    notb = T.node("FunctionNodeBooleanMath", -500, 0, operation="NOT")
    T.link(rc, "Is Hit", notb, 0)
    T.link(notb, "Boolean", dele, "Selection")
    setp = T.node("GeometryNodeSetPosition", -200, 200)
    T.link(dele, "Geometry", setp, "Geometry")
    T.link(rc, "Hit Position", setp, "Position")
    # flicker: each splash is visible for 15% of its cycle, growing then shrinking
    ph0 = _rand(T, "FLOAT", 0.0, 1.0, 11, -400, -400)
    ph = T.math("FRACT", T.math("ADD", T.math("MULTIPLY", sock(st, "Seconds", True), sock(gi, "Rate", True), -400, -550), ph0, -250, -500), None, -100, -500)
    on = T.math("LESS_THAN", ph, 0.15, 50, -500)
    grow = T.map_range(ph, 0.0, 0.15, 0.3, 1.0, 50, -650)
    s = T.math("MULTIPLY", T.math("MULTIPLY", on, grow, 200, -550), sock(gi, "Size", True), 350, -550)
    crown = T.node("GeometryNodeMeshCylinder", -100, 600, in_Vertices=10, in_Radius=1.0, in_Depth=0.6, fill_type="NONE")
    lift = T.node("GeometryNodeTransform", 100, 600, in_Translation=(0, 0, 0.3), in_Scale=(1, 1, 1))
    T.link(crown, "Mesh", lift, "Geometry")
    mat = T.node("GeometryNodeSetMaterial", 300, 600)
    T.link(lift, "Geometry", mat, "Geometry")
    T.link(gi, "Material", mat, "Material")
    inst = T.node("GeometryNodeInstanceOnPoints", 600, 200)
    T.link(setp, "Geometry", inst, "Points")
    T.link(mat, "Geometry", inst, "Instance")
    T.l.new(s, sock(inst, "Scale"))
    T.link(inst, "Instances", go, "Geometry")
    return ng


def build_droplets():

    r = T.math("MULTIPLY", T.math("POWER", r, 2.0, -350, -400), sock(gi, "Size", True), -200, -400)

    T.link(scv, "Vector", inst, "Scale")

def _mat(name):
    m = bpy.data.materials.new(name)
    m.use_nodes = True
    m.node_tree.nodes.clear()
    return m, Tree(m.node_tree)


def build_rain_mat():
    m, T = _mat("LK Rain")
    out = T.node("ShaderNodeOutputMaterial", 600, 0)
    pb = T.node("ShaderNodeBsdfPrincipled", 0, 0, in_Base_Color=(0.8, 0.85, 0.9, 1), in_Roughness=0.15,
                in_Emission_Color=(0.75, 0.8, 0.9, 1), in_Emission_Strength=0.15)
    pb.name = "LK Rain Surface"
    tr = T.node("ShaderNodeBsdfTransparent", 0, 300)
    mix = T.node("ShaderNodeMixShader", 300, 0, in_Factor=0.35)
    mix.name = "LK Rain Opacity"
    T.link(tr, "BSDF", mix, 1)
    T.link(pb, "BSDF", mix, 2)
    T.link(mix, "Shader", out, "Surface")
    m.surface_render_method = "DITHERED"  # blended sorting of 30k streaks costs 3-4x on an L4
    m.use_transparent_shadow = True
    return m

def build_droplet_mat():
    m, T = _mat("LK Droplet")
    out = T.node("ShaderNodeOutputMaterial", 400, 0)
    # clear water: a thin glossy coat that mostly shows what's behind (refraction through tiny beads is invisible
    # at product distance; the highlight and a slight darkening are what read as water)
    pb = T.node("ShaderNodeBsdfPrincipled", 0, 0, in_Base_Color=(0.02, 0.02, 0.025, 1), in_Roughness=0.02, in_IOR=1.33,
                in_Coat_Weight=1.0, in_Coat_Roughness=0.01)

    tr = T.node("ShaderNodeBsdfTransparent", 0, 300)
    # see-through centre, darker glossy rim (how a bead reads at product distance)
    lw = T.node("ShaderNodeLayerWeight", -200, 200, in_Blend=0.35)
    rim = T.map_range(sock(lw, "Facing", True), 0.0, 1.0, 0.15, 0.95, 0, 200)
    mix = T.node("ShaderNodeMixShader", 250, 0)
    T.l.new(rim, sock(mix, "Factor"))
    T.link(tr, "BSDF", mix, 1)
    T.link(pb, "BSDF", mix, 2)
    T.link(mix, "Shader", out, "Surface")
    m.surface_render_method = "BLENDED"
    return m

        return dict(BASE, **LOOKS[name][1])
    if name in LAYERS:
        p = dict(BASE, **LAYERS[name][1])
        p["exposure"] = p["exposure"] if name == "camera" else None  # layers keep the scene's exposure
        return p
    raise KeyError(name)


def coerce(key, text):
    default = PARAMS[key][0]
    if isinstance(default, bool):
        return text.lower() in ("1", "true", "yes", "on")
    if isinstance(default, (int, float)) and not isinstance(default, bool):
        return type(default)(float(text)) if isinstance(default, int) else float(text)
    if isinstance(default, tuple):
        vals = tuple(float(v) for v in text.replace(" ", "").split(","))
        return vals
    if key in ("exposure", "sun_azimuth"):
        return text if text == "auto" else float(text)
    return text
